title: Date Picker
description: A calendar that opens under the input — real month math, a core dot for today, no library.
usage: For single dates: deadlines, start dates, birthdays. Ranges and time are separate problems; this part does one day, completely.
a11y: Full keyboard support: arrows move by day and week, Page Up/Down by month, Enter selects, Esc closes. The grid is a real table-like structure with weekday headers, and today carries aria-current="date".
